citation: Cade WT, Khoury N, Nelson S, et al. Hypoglycemia during moderate intensity exercise reduces counterregulatory responses to subsequent hypoglycemia. Physiological Reports. 2016.
protocol: Day 1: bed rest or two 90-min bouts of cycling at ~70% peak VO2, with or without dextrose infusion; day 2 (24 h later): stepped hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic-hypoglycaemic clamp (glucose 90, 55, 45 mg/dL)
population: n=18 healthy adults in two arms of 9 (Arm 1: 4 M/5 F, age 31.0+/-10.2, BMI 25.3+/-6.2)

reports.where: Table 1 (by glucose step, following rest vs exercise)
figures and text (not verified in tables)

note: Cardiovascular responses are tabulated; counter-regulatory hormones were not seen in a table. The abstract states ~70% peak VO2 (an introduction sentence cites a 50% study). Clamp day is a hypoglycaemia protocol, outside pulse's euglycaemic clamp.
